senses.gloss:
1 सह॑ adv. together, in common, along with (mostly ˚— or as
prep. w. instr.).
सहकारिता f. ˚त्व n. abstr. to seq.
सहखट्वासन n. sitting together on a bed.
सहचार॑ m. going together, harmony, agreement.

सहज॑ a. born at the same time or together with (gen.);
innate, inherent, natural.
सहजा॑ a. born or produced at the same time.
सहजन्य m. आ f. N. of a Yakṣa & an Apsaras.
सहजेन्द्र m. N. of a man.

सह॑देव a. with the gods;
 m. N. of a Pāṇḍava etc.
सहनीय a. to be endured or pardoned.

स॑हन्तम (superl.) overpowering most, mightiest or
strongest.
सहपांसुक्रीडन n. playing together with sand.

सहपिण्डक्रिया f. the common offering of the
funeral cake.

सहभू a. appearing together with (—˚);
 inborn, natural.
सह॑मूर a. along with the root.
सह॑˚मूल a. along with the root.
सहयायिन् a. going along with, m. fellow-traveller.
सहयुज् a. yoked or harnessed together.
सहर्ष a. joyful, merry, n. adv.
सहवाहन a. with the team, carriage etc.

स॑हस् a. powerful, victorious. n. power, might, victory;
instr. sgl. & pl. strongly, violently, suddenly, at once.
सहासन n. सहास्या f. sitting together.
सहस्कृ॑त् a. giving power or strength.

सहस्कृत a. strengthened^1, excited.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

सहस्थ a. standing by, present;
 m. companion.

सह˚स्थित a. standing by, present;
 m. companion.

सह॑स्र n. (m.) a thousand (used also for any very large
number).
सहस्रजि॑त् a. vanquishing or conquering a thousand.
सहस्रणी m. chief of a thousand (or thousands).
सह॑स्रणीति a. having a thousand ways.
सह॑स्रणीथ a. knowing a thousand songs or = prec.

सह॑स्रदक्षिण a. (a sacrificer) giving or (a
sacrifice) whereat are given a thousand (cows) as a fee.
सहस्रधा॑ adv. in a thousand ways or parts.

सहस्रधा॑यस् a. nourishing or supporting
thousands.
सह॑स्रधार a. flowing in a thousand streams.

सहस्रनयन a. thousand-eyed;
 m. E. of Indra.
सह॑स्रनिर्णिज् a. having a thousand ornaments.
सहस्रपति m. the chief of a thousand (villages).

सह॑स्रपद् a. thousand-footed;
 m. N. of a Ṛṣi.

(सहस्र˚पाद्) a. thousand-footed;
 m. N. of a Ṛṣi.

सह॑स्रपर्ण f. ई॑ having a thousand leaves or
feathers.

1 सहस्रपोष॑ m. ˚पोषा f., ˚पोष्य॑ n. thousandfold
prosperity.
सह॑स्रबाहु a. having a thousand arms.
सह॑स्रमुष्क a. having a thousand testicles.
सह॑स्रमूति a. helping in a thousand ways.
सहस्रयज्ञ॑ m. a sacrifice of a thousand (animals).
सह॑स्रवाज a. having a thousand forces.
सह॑स्रवीर a. sufficient for a thousand men.
सह॑स्रवीर्य a. having a thousand forces.

सहस्रशत॑दक्षिण a. whereat a hundred
thousand (cows) are given as a fee (sacrifice).
साहस्रशस् adv. in a thousand ways.
सह॑स्रशोकस् a. sparkling with a thousand flames.
सहस्रसंख्य a. amounting to a thousand.
सहस्रसनि॑ a. winning or bestowing a thousand.
सहस्र˚सा॑ a. winning or bestowing a thousand.
सहस्रसाव॑ m. a thousandfold pressing (of Soma).

सहस्राधिपति m. the chief of a thousand (men or
villages).

सह॑स्रामघ a. having a thousand treasures or
gifts.
सहस्रायु a. living a thousand years.

सह॑स्रायुस् m. = prec.;
 m. N. of a man.

स॑हस्वन्त् a. powerful, mighty;
 n. adv.
सहायता f. ˚त्व n. abstr. to prec.
सहायन n. going along with, company.

सहायवन्त् a. having a companion or attendant;
accompanied or attended by, furnished with (—˚).

सहास a. laughing or smiling;
 n. adv.
सहितव्य a. to be borne or endured.

सहिष्णु a. bearing, enduring (acc., gen., or —˚);
patient, forbearing.

स॑हृदय a. with the heart;
 hearty, affectionate.
सहेतु a. having a cause, reason, or motive.
सहेतु˚क a. having a cause, reason, or motive.

सहेल a. playful, careless;
 n. adv.
सहोजा॑ a. produced by power, strong.
सहोषित a. who has lived with another.
सहौ॑जस् a. endowed with power or strength.

†सह्य a. to be borne or endured, tolerable, resistible^1
(abstr. ˚ता f.);
 N. of a mountain.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
साहंकार a. full of egoism, selfish.

साहचर्य n. being or standing together, being joined or
united with (instr. or —˚).

साहसकर्मता f. committing rash or violent acts;
rashness, temerity.*
साहसकारिन् a. acting violently or inconsiderately.
साहसिक f. ई bold, rash, violent.
साहस्रिक a. consisting of a thousand, the thousandth.

साहित्यदर्पण m. mirror of composition, T. of a
work.
साह्न॑ a. of a day's length or duration.

साह्लाद a. cheerful, merry;
 n. adv.
